parts.name: Overhead Ionizer with Light, 3-Fan, 120VAC

Sealed Plenum Air Flow prevents contamination from being introduced to workstation
NIST Calibrated

Ionization performance is consistent at all three speeds and allows for use with sensitive applications, such as calibration, test, or repair procedures
Active balancing system with audible and visual alarm
NIST Calibrated

parts.name: Mini Monitor
parts.description: ESD monitor that continuously checks the path-to-ground integrity of one operator and one ESD work surface, with color indicator lights and an audible alarm.
features: Continuously monitors the path-to-ground integrity of one operator and one ESD work surface
Illuminates green to indicate proper grounding; illuminates red and sounds audible alarm when intermittent or failed connection occurs; illuminates blue to indicate standby mode
Single-wire impedance design grounds and monitors the work surface
<50 millisecond alarm response time identifies failures and intermittencies that inferior technologies miss
Park delay timer and ParkSnap™ indicates the 8-second delay to disconnect and park the operator wrist cord without creating a false alarm
Included with monitor: 100-240VAC NRTL power adapter with North American plug, washers (2), and flat head screws 6-32 x 3/8” (2)
parts.notes: Included with monitor: 100-240VAC NRTL power adapter with North American plug, washers (2), and flat head screws 6-32 x 3/8” (2). Row badged F and M (metric).

corrected: CO-SLM: description "Zinc-finished steel male half of a spring loaded tow bar; combined with the female CO-SLF it links carts into a tugger train for material handling." -> "Zinc-finished steel spring loaded tow bar (male) with a max towing capacity of 1,570 lbs; combined with the female CO-SLF it provides a lean tugger-train method for material handling."

CO-SLF: description "Zinc-finished steel female half of a spring loaded tow bar; combined with the male CO-SLM it links carts into a tugger train for material handling." -> "Zinc-finished steel spring loaded tow bar (female) with a max towing capacity of 1,570 lbs; combined with the male CO-SLM it provides a lean tugger-train method for material handling."

12335: description "120VAC overhead three-fan ionizer with light for static control in electronics manufacturing areas; NIST calibrated." -> "120VAC overhead three-fan ionizer with light whose discharge time and offset voltage meet the limits for ionization use in electronics manufacturing areas; NIST calibrated."

12334: description "Adjustable ESD wrist strap with an extra wide elastic band and a 6’ coil cord ending in a banana plug." -> "Adjustable wrist strap with an extra wide, soft elastic band knitted inside with silver impregnated polypropylene for conductivity, and a 6’ coil cord with a spring supported banana plug."

2679: dimension_notes "A and B = angle leg dimensions; C = overall rail length; hole pattern repeats every 1.750” (45mm) (1 Space); the rack-mounting flange holes are 10-32 threads" -> "A and B = angle leg dimensions; C = overall rail length; hole pattern repeats every 1.750” (45mm) (1 Space); the holes in the lower view (dimensions L-P) are 10-32 threads"
remaining_doubts: 65-2851 (Light-Duty Adhesive Clamp, metric-dimensioned listing) is kept because its row is printed with the F and M badges, although its 65- part number and mm/kg values mark it as the metric variant of 2851.
2679 metric weight is printed as .1930 kg, which does not match 5.20 lb; both kept verbatim.
2680 Height is printed as 433” (no decimal point); kept verbatim.
CO-SLM/CO-SLF feature text says 'SO-SLF' (catalog typo); kept verbatim. The P-series hardware row (qty 4, attach to pipe using included U-Bolts) is in notes, not suggested_hardware.
Page 754 Connector Rod Profile 9820 is RT only; its suggested bolt 3754 (F badge) appears only in a suggested-hardware table, so no standalone part was made.
